offering_description.value: Operates rural local exchange telephone companies and broadband networks in the US. Sells voice, broadband internet, video and network access services to residential and business customers and carriers, delivered over its own fiber and copper networks.

primary_services.value: broadband internet access; local telephone service; carrier network access; video service; business communications services

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential subscribers in rural communities; B2B: businesses and other telecom carriers using network access

end_markets.value: rural telecommunications; broadband; residential and business communications

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly broadband, voice and video subscriptions; service fees: carrier access charges and business services; other: federal and state universal service support

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs fiber and copper telecom networks, selling to subscribers and carriers; service provider: provides communications services to rural households and businesses

geography_served.value: US regional: Rural service areas in several states, including Pennsylvania, Indiana, Ohio, Michigan, Wisconsin, Washington and Oregon

specialization.value: related lines: broadband, telephone, video and network access services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and customer service to subscribers and business accounts; own locations: local company offices in service areas

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Licensed local exchange carriers regulated by the FCC and state public utility commissions, with universal service rules

notes: Exact state list and set of operating companies are approximate.
